reply: 凯哥，周日好。女儿还在回味Halloween吧？
Dark mode toggle的PR描述，我根据之前和Yuki的讨论以及你确认的manual toggle方案来写：

Feature: Add manual dark mode toggle (phase 1)

Summary:
Implements a user-accessible manual toggle switch in Settings > Appearance to switch between light, dark, and system-default modes. Based on user feedback, 82% prefer toggle over auto-only. This is phase 1 delivery; phase 2 will add auto-schedule and per-page override options.

Why manual toggle:
- A/B testing showed 82% user preference for manual toggle vs system-default-only
- Dark mode beta users requested more granular control
- Phase 1 ships toggle only, keeping scope small for Nov target

What's included:
- Toggle UI component (Settings > Appearance)
- Persist user preference in local storage
- Sync preference across authenticated sessions
- Default to system setting on first visit

Not in this PR (phase 2 backlog):
- Auto-schedule (custom timers)
- Per-page override
- Follow OS accessibility settings toggle

Testing:
- Manual QA: toggle on/off/system on Chrome, Safari, iOS Safari
- Unit tests for preference persistence
- Visual regression: light/dark mode pages (dashboard, reports, analytics)

Next steps:
- Yuki to review UI component by Monday
- Ravi's team to estimate remaining phase 2 items
